aggregate.scope: Local regtest RPC block replay/catch-up component overhead; not network/mainnet IBD

sampling.page_cache: uncontrolled OS page cache; warmed persistent-loopback HTTP requests

limitations: Synthetic consensus-valid anyone-can-spend scripts, no signature cost; not production transaction distribution.
RPC block replay is not P2P sync or a network/mainnet IBD throughput claim.
Rebuild wall time includes chainstate open/startup; post-RPC delta is not total rebuild time.
Disk metric is sum(st_blocks*512) for stopped index files; directory metadata excluded, no physical-device amplification or peak-allocation claim.
Primary replay times vary materially; no reliable small wall-time gain/regression claim.
Dense comparisons have one matched pair; observations are not stable multi-run estimates.
Process CPU/HWM/I/O counters are sampled at readiness, not after shutdown; OS CPU accounting is quantized.
Pilot runs are excluded. No Cargo or other local build ran during the benchmark campaign.
